name: Indiscriminate Purge
summary: An apprentice of Lady Amberhall asks you to face void-infused ogres beneath Sunnyglade. The Twilight’s Hammer will feel the losses.

sections.title: Below Sunnyglade
sections.body: Lady Amberhall’s apprentice was taken by ogres and their masters in the caves beneath Sunnyglade. She asks you to put down the Twilight Ritualists and Empowered Brutes there. The losses will strike the Twilight’s Hammer.

faq.q: Who asks for help beneath Sunnyglade?
faq.answer: Lady Amberhall’s apprentice asks you to kill the ogres in the caves beneath Sunnyglade.
The caves beneath Sunnyglade hold void-infused ogres and their masters.
The apprentice identifies the ogres’ masters as Twilight Ritualists.

faq.q: Which ogres does the apprentice name?
faq.answer: She names Empowered Brutes among the beasts in the caves.

faq.q: Why does the apprentice ask you to kill them?
faq.answer: She says that nothing good comes from fanatics with a purpose, empowered or otherwise.

faq.q: What does the apprentice say about her own abilities?
faq.answer: She says she is usually capable of handling things on her own, but the ogres captured her.
